steps.title: Perception service: port fusePerception + face/body/biometric extractors into a real, callable service
steps.task: Create services/perception-service.js exporting hasConsent, extractFaceEvidence, extractBodyEvidence, extractBiometricEvidence, detectPositiveSignals, and fusePerception -- a deterministic port of the already-proven prototype scripts/prototype-perception-v3.mjs (27/27 tests). Import extractTranscriptEvidence, extractTonalityEvidence, fuseEvidence from ./evidence-fusion-service.js (already shipped) rather than redefining them. No AI/model call anywhere in this file. Do not include the prototype's self-test auto-execution code or its dotenv/assert imports.
non_goals: real camera/wearable signal collection -- fusion logic only, operates on already-collected frame data
any AI/model call -- this must remain deterministic like the proven prototype
wiring into any live product surface (V4/V5's job)
